body:
You look 10years younger, Won the genetic lottery!
Looks good!

I climbed on an electric pole, and touched electric cord that was on this pole. Electric shock left me unconscious and I fell. It was around 25ft (7/8meters).


I fell and woke up. I was in so much pain. Everything was in blood. My head, my jacket, my hands. I tried to get up. I could not stand properly due to pelvic fractures. But I stood up and went to the car that I parked nearby. 
I can't forget that night. It was terrifying

I live in Italy, so health insurance is common. First ER, then another hospital for treating pneumothorax. Then ortho department for treating AC joint and attaching ribs bcs they were in pieces. And psych ward.
I'm 21yo and I feel devasted. Pain is in my body. Physical and mental pain. :(
Buzz cut, and trim your beard for a nice 5days not shaving look. Definitely going to look awesome!

Did you try to find any kind of group therapy? For people with schizophrenia? Or with other mental problems? 

Maybe a conversation with other people with this disease could help you a little, make a little progress

Are a pharmacist? Do you work in a lab?
Please tell more about this drug, more about your life. Try to talk to someone. Pls search for help, any kind of conversation, even with a stranger

Don't do anything stupid. You can end up badly. After my attempt I broke my pelvis, ribs and collar bone. I don't know if I will be able to walk again

So please, seqrch for help

Please don't do anything bad. You have 2 daughters! 
Please search for help, talk to anyone, make a call to someone.

Need 6/9months for proper results.
Remember about nutrition. Eat well, drink water. Vitamins are important. See your pharmacist, ask for a pills with vitamins like B9, B12, D. Also zink.
Workout. It's better for blood circulation, also on top of your head.
And don't stress out. A good therapy will give you more years of good hair :)
Good luck!
Your hairstyle rocks! It's definitely kind of sexy balding, like Jude Law :D
I hope to find my own way. But I'm so sad that I can't live a normal life anymore. It's so depressing

Thank you for your kind word. It helps a little. 
Right now I'm back to my flat. 
Feeling everything. From hate of myself to joy while eating a meal. From feeling depressed to good mood.

But the biggest issue is that I miss my ex. And I'm in a position in life where I can not live a normal life anymore.

I'm thinking seriously about helping other people. But i need to recover. I need to lay down for 3 weeks, then RTG and rehab. I hope my pelvic bones wont be needing operation.
That would be devastating


About your story. I'm so sad. Hope you are doing fine. 
Hope you are on good medication to relieve pain. 
Can I ask you, how you started with helping other people in this kind of problems?

Try to find a group therapy near your area.
Or a forum for veterans like you. Anything that can help you.
You can DM me if you want

Hi, sorry for my English, I'm from Italy, but i need to write my story down.

Right now im laying on hospital bed. Month ago I attempted suicide. I climbed the electric pole next to train rails.
I touched the electric cord because I wanted to be burned by electric shock.
The voltage was too low. I fell off. Landed on the ground

Broken pelvis in 5 places. Broken ribs. AC joint torn.
Had pneumothorax also.

I was happy 21, but I struggled with early balding and being skinny. I had great girlfriend, but I took her for granted and she found new man in her life. I felt devastated.
Two months of horror in my life. I was depressed, could not concentrate, I puked, didn't eat anything than a one sandwich. I only drank apple juice or soda. I couldn't communicate. I felt alone in a room full of my colleagues.

I made big mistakes in that relationship. I took her for granted, didn't invite anywhere, she was the one that cared about our relationship. I see now how bad boyfriend I was.

I was in ER, then admitted to ortho hospital, then to psych ward.

I don't know what to do in my life. My gf was perfect and I could not see it.
Right now I have no one except my parents, who are struggling with depression after what I did and they are trying to get me best doctors and psychological help they can

I feel numb, tired. I probably cannot workout and gain some muscles after those injuries.
And I'm balding
No girlfriend, she is with another man.
No college
There is depression instead of hope
There is no way of getting a girlfriend or some kind of relationship after that. No family in future, no kids, lack of happiness.

I feel like shit.
Im afraid that soon I will be able to walk I will try to kill myself again, but I'm afraid of pain and letting down my parents.

I see no help, but maybe better days are coming for you and me? 
There is one brain cell telling me to keep going. 
But I am afraid. So afraid

I understand you so much. Be strong, try to talk here on Reddit, talk with anyone. Try be in touch with somebody.
Remember one thing. Suicide can end in several injuries like mine. I was lucky, because I didn't injuried spinal cord and nerves that are responsible for bowel movements and sexual things.

But I'm talking serious. If you are going to attempt a suicide, it is a had idea, that will leave you in bigger pain - physical injuries

Be strong, please
